blocks.text: Superfluids aisa anokha behaviour dikhate hain jo aam fluids aur gases mein nahi hota. Maslan helium-3 bartan ki deewaron par charh kar bahar nikal sakta hai; ise film flow kehte hain. Yeh bartan ki deewaron mein se bhi guzar sakta hai. Hilane par superfluids mein bhanwar (vortices) bante hain jo khatam nahi hote, jab ke aam fluids kuch der baad ruk jate hain. Superfluid ka bartan ghumayein to andar ka liquid ruka rehta hai, coffee ke cup ki tarah saath nahi ghoomta. Superfluid mein normal aur superfluid dono hisse mile hote hain; temperature jitna kam, superfluid hissa utna zyada. Kuch superfluids garmi bohat achhi guzarte hain (high thermal conductivity). Yaad rahe ke superfluidity aur superconductivity alag cheezein hain; helium-3 aur helium-4 dono superfluid hain magar bijli nahi guzarte.
